PPWR stands for Packaging and Packaging.en: PPWR stands for Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. Regulation (EU) 2025/40 sets rules for packaging placed on the EU market and covers topics such as packaging design, recyclability and producer responsibility.
PPWR stands for Packaging and Packaging.da: PPWR står for Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. EU-forordning 2025/40 fastsætter regler for emballage på EU-markedet og omfatter blandt andet emballagedesign, genanvendelighed og producentansvar.

The PPWR has generally applied since 12.en: The PPWR has generally applied since 12 August 2026. Some provisions and specific requirements apply on other dates. Check the dates for the requirement and packaging in question.

PPWR is the EU regulation on packaging a.en: PPWR is the EU regulation on packaging and packaging waste. In Denmark, the responsible producer generally first makes the packaging available on the Danish market. Rules vary with packaging type and role, including certain cases of unpacking. Check who must register with Dansk Producentansvar and finance waste management.
PPWR is the EU regulation on packaging a.da: PPWR er EU’s forordning om emballage og emballageaffald. I Danmark er den ansvarlige producent som hovedregel den, der først gør emballagen tilgængelig på det danske marked. Reglerne afhænger af emballagetype og rolle, herunder visse tilfælde af udpakning. Afklar, hvem der skal registreres hos Dansk Producentansvar og finansiere affaldshåndteringen.

Map who makes, imports, distributes or u.en: Map who makes, imports, distributes or unpacks the packaging in each market. Use Article 3 and Chapter IV (Articles 15–23) for roles and duties. Check producer registration under Article 44 and the national rules, including the Danish Packaging Order for Denmark.
Map who makes, imports, distributes or u.da: Kortlæg, hvem der fremstiller, importerer, distribuerer eller udpakker emballagen på hvert marked. Brug artikel 3 og kapitel IV (artikel 15–23) til at afklare roller og pligter. Tjek producentregistrering efter artikel 44 og de nationale regler, herunder emballagebekendtgørelsen i Danmark.

You can use the test without saving a ch.da: I kan bruge testen uden at gemme en tjekliste. Vælger I at gemme, kan jeres svar og afkrydsninger gendannes i denne browser i 30 dage fra lagringen. I kan slette dem, når I vil. Udløbne resultater fjernes, næste gang I åbner sitet.

What do you do with this packaging?.da: Hvad gør I med denne emballage?

Choose one activity to investigate first.en: Choose one activity to investigate first. You may have several roles. Assess manufacturer duties and extended producer responsibility for packaging waste separately.
Choose one activity to investigate first.da: Vælg én aktivitet at undersøge først. I kan have flere roller. Vurdér fabrikantens pligter og producentansvaret for emballageaffald hver for sig.

We have packaging or packed products mad.en: We have packaging or packed products made under our own brand
We have packaging or packed products mad.da: Vi får emballage eller emballerede varer fremstillet under eget mærke

We buy packaging or packed products with.en: We buy packaging or packed products within the EU
We buy packaging or packed products with.da: Vi køber emballage eller emballerede varer inden for EU

We distribute packaging or packed produc.en: We distribute packaging or packed products
We distribute packaging or packed produc.da: Vi distribuerer emballage eller emballerede varer

Where is this packaging or packed produc.en: Where is this packaging or packed product first made available in the course of business?
Where is this packaging or packed produc.da: Hvor gøres denne emballage eller emballerede vare første gang tilgængelig som led i erhverv?

Consider each country. Include free samp.en: Consider each country. Include free samples and cross-border deliveries. If you unpack goods without being the end user, check whether that gives you producer responsibility.
Consider each country. Include free samp.da: Se på hvert land for sig. Medregn gratis vareprøver og leverancer på tværs af grænser. Hvis I pakker varer ud uden selv at være slutbruger, skal I undersøge, om det giver jer producentansvar.

Inside and outside the EU, including Den.en: Inside and outside the EU, including Denmark
Inside and outside the EU, including Den.da: I og uden for EU, herunder Danmark

Inside and outside the EU, excluding Den.en: Inside and outside the EU, excluding Denmark
Inside and outside the EU, excluding Den.da: I og uden for EU, uden Danmark

What is the packaging made of?.en: What is the packaging made of?

Choose the material and indicate whether.en: Choose the material and indicate whether the packaging is intended to come into contact with food.
Choose the material and indicate whether.da: Vælg materiale, og angiv, om emballagen er beregnet til at komme i kontakt med fødevarer.

Is it intended for food contact?.en: Is it intended for food contact?

A country list with the first supply, th.en: A country list with the first supply, the responsible business and any registration deadline.
A country list with the first supply, th.da: En landeliste med første tilgængeliggørelse, ansvarlig virksomhed og eventuel registreringsfrist.

Identify who makes the packaging or pack.en: Identify who makes the packaging or packed product for the EU market. Agree who holds the technical file and signs the EU declaration of conformity.
Identify who makes the packaging or pack.da: Afklar, hvem der fremstiller emballagen eller den emballerede vare til EU-markedet. Aftal, hvem der har den tekniske dokumentation og underskriver EU-overensstemmelseserklæringen.

If you commission packaging or a packed.en: If you commission packaging or a packed product under your own brand, you are normally the manufacturer. For a microenterprise using a packaging supplier in the same Member State, the supplier is the manufacturer under Article 3(1)(13)(b). Check producer responsibility separately.
If you commission packaging or a packed.da: Får I emballage eller en emballeret vare fremstillet under eget mærke, er I normalt fabrikant. For en mikrovirksomhed med en emballageleverandør i samme medlemsstat er leverandøren fabrikant efter artikel 3, stk. 1, nr. 13, litra b. Undersøg producentansvaret særskilt.

Record the supplier and where the packag.en: Record the supplier and where the packaging first entered the EU market. Buying from Sweden does not in itself make a Danish buyer a PPWR importer. If you resupply the packaging, assess distributor duties and whether you are the producer in Denmark.
Record the supplier and where the packag.da: Notér leverandøren, og hvor emballagen først kom på EU-markedet. Indkøb fra Sverige gør ikke i sig selv en dansk køber til importør efter PPWR. Hvis I leverer emballagen videre, skal I undersøge distributørpligterne og jeres eventuelle producentansvar i Danmark.

Identify who is established in the EU an.en: Identify who is established in the EU and first places the packaging from the non-EU country on the EU market. If you place packaging under your own name or modify it in a way that can affect compliance, check whether manufacturer duties also apply.
Identify who is established in the EU an.da: Afklar, hvem der er etableret i EU og først bringer emballagen fra tredjelandet i omsætning i EU. Hvis I bringer emballagen i omsætning under eget navn eller ændrer den på en måde, der kan påvirke overensstemmelsen, skal I undersøge, om I også har fabrikantpligter.

Record who supplies each packaging item.en: Record who supplies each packaging item and which business is the registered producer for each market. Check your distributor duties before making the packaging available.
Record who supplies each packaging item.da: Registrér, hvem der leverer hver emballage, og hvem der er registreret som producent på hvert marked. Tjek distributørpligterne, før I gør emballagen tilgængelig.

List packaging you add, including labels.en: List packaging you add, including labels, tape and fill. Clarify whether you are the manufacturer, who has producer responsibility, and which rules on empty space apply to the packaging you fill.
List packaging you add, including labels.da: Notér den emballage, I tilføjer, herunder etiketter, tape og fyld. Afklar, om I er fabrikant, hvem der har producentansvaret, og hvilke regler om tomrum der gælder for den emballage, I fylder.

Identify who makes, buys, imports, fills.en: Identify who makes, buys, imports, fills, supplies or unpacks this packaging. Check all relevant roles and the same-Member-State supplier rule for microenterprises using their own brand.
Identify who makes, buys, imports, fills.da: Afklar, hvem der fremstiller, køber, importerer, fylder, leverer eller udpakker emballagen. Undersøg alle relevante roller og særreglen for mikrovirksomheder med eget mærke og emballageleverandør i samme medlemsstat.

Record when and how the packaging is fir.en: Record when and how the packaging is first supplied in Denmark, including samples.
Record when and how the packaging is fir.da: Notér, hvornår og hvordan emballagen første gang leveres i Danmark, inklusive vareprøver.

List Denmark and each other EU country s.en: List Denmark and each other EU country separately, with the first supply and the responsible producer.
List Denmark and each other EU country s.da: Notér Danmark og hvert andet EU-land for sig med første tilgængeliggørelse og ansvarlig producent.

List each EU country separately and chec.en: List each EU country separately and check its producer register. Direct deliveries to end users in another Member State can trigger producer responsibility there.
List each EU country separately and chec.da: Notér hvert EU-land for sig, og tjek dets producentregister. Direkte leverancer til slutbrugere i en anden medlemsstat kan udløse producentansvar dér.

Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Lis.en: Separate EU and non-EU destinations. List Denmark and each other EU country separately. Check the rules in each non-EU destination.
Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Lis.da: Adskil markeder i og uden for EU. Notér Danmark og hvert andet EU-land for sig. Tjek reglerne på hvert marked uden for EU.

Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Che.en: Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Check the producer register in each relevant EU country and the rules in each non-EU destination.
Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Che.da: Adskil markeder i og uden for EU. Tjek producentregistret i hvert relevant EU-land og reglerne på hvert marked uden for EU.

Check the destination’s rules. If this p.en: Check the destination’s rules. If this packaging is only supplied outside the EU, it is outside the EU market requirements described here. Verify whether the packaging is first supplied or relevant unpacking occurs in the EU before export. If so, reassess your EU and national obligations.
Check the destination’s rules. If this p.da: Tjek reglerne på destinationsmarkedet. Hvis emballagen kun tilgængeliggøres uden for EU, falder den uden for de EU-markedskrav, der beskrives her. Undersøg, om emballagen først leveres, eller om relevant udpakning sker i EU før eksport. Hvis ja, skal I vurdere EU-krav og nationale pligter igen.

Map the first commercial supply in each.en: Map the first commercial supply in each country from orders, dispatches, free samples and direct sales. Check whether unpacking without being the end user affects your producer role.
Map the first commercial supply in each.da: Kortlæg den første erhvervsmæssige tilgængeliggørelse i hvert land ud fra ordrer, forsendelser, gratis vareprøver og direkte salg. Undersøg, om udpakning uden at være slutbruger påvirker jeres producentrolle.

If you are the manufacturer, carry out o.en: If you are the manufacturer, carry out or commission the conformity assessment and compile the technical documentation before placing the packaging on the EU market. Once compliance is demonstrated, draw up the EU declaration of conformity. Keep both documents for five years for single-use packaging and ten years for reusable packaging, from placing on the market.
If you are the manufacturer, carry out o.da: Er I fabrikant, skal I gennemføre eller få udført overensstemmelsesvurderingen og udarbejde teknisk dokumentation, før emballagen bringes i omsætning i EU. Når overensstemmelse er påvist, skal I udarbejde EU-overensstemmelseserklæringen. Gem begge dokumenter i fem år for engangsemballage og ti år for genbrugsemballage, regnet fra omsætningen.

Before placing imported packaging on the.en: Before placing imported packaging on the EU market, verify that the manufacturer has carried out the assessment and compiled the technical file, that required documents and applicable labelling are in place, and that the manufacturer’s identification and contact requirements are met. Add your importer identification and contact details as required. Keep a copy of the EU declaration and ensure the technical file is available to the authorities.
Before placing imported packaging on the.da: Før I bringer importeret emballage i omsætning i EU, skal I kontrollere fabrikantens vurdering og tekniske dokumentation, de krævede dokumenter og den mærkning, der gælder, samt fabrikantens identifikation og kontaktoplysninger. Tilføj de krævede oplysninger om jer som importør. Gem en kopi af EU-overensstemmelseserklæringen, og sørg for, at myndighederne kan få den tekniske dokumentation.

If you distribute the packaging, check p.en: If you distribute the packaging, check producer registration, any applicable Article 12 labelling, and the manufacturer’s and importer’s required identification and contact details before making it available. Hold back packaging if you have reason to believe it fails the applicable requirements.
If you distribute the packaging, check p.da: Distribuerer I emballagen, skal I før tilgængeliggørelsen kontrollere producentregistrering, eventuel gældende mærkning efter artikel 12 og fabrikantens og importørens krævede identifikation og kontaktoplysninger. Hold emballagen tilbage, hvis I har grund til at tro, at den ikke opfylder de gældende krav.

A producer covered by section 15 must re.en: A producer covered by section 15 must register with Dansk Producentansvar at least 14 days before first making the packaging available on the Danish market.
A producer covered by section 15 must re.da: En producent omfattet af emballagebekendtgørelsens § 15 skal registreres hos Dansk Producentansvar senest 14 dage før første tilgængeliggørelse på det danske marked.

List fibres, coatings, inks and adhesive.en: List fibres, coatings, inks and adhesives.
List fibres, coatings, inks and adhesive.da: Registrér fibre, belægninger, trykfarver og lim.

Record the polymers and identify which p.en: Record the polymers and identify which parts contain plastic.
Record the polymers and identify which p.da: Notér polymertyperne, og registrér, hvilke dele der indeholder plast.

Record the glass type and separate closu.en: Record the glass type and separate closures, labels and coatings in your list.
Record the glass type and separate closu.da: Notér glastypen, og registrér lukninger, etiketter og belægninger særskilt.

Record the metal type and separate linin.en: Record the metal type and separate linings, closures and labels in your list.
Record the metal type and separate linin.da: Notér metaltypen, og registrér indvendige belægninger, lukninger og etiketter særskilt.

Record each layer or component, includin.en: Record each layer or component, including any plastic, and note what can be separated.
Record each layer or component, includin.da: Registrér hvert lag eller hver del, herunder eventuel plast, og notér, hvad der kan skilles ad.

Identify the material and each component.en: Identify the material and each component with the supplier.
Identify the material and each component.da: Afklar materialet og de enkelte dele med leverandøren.

For packaging placed on the EU market, t.en: For packaging placed on the EU market, the design-for-recycling criteria apply from 1 January 2030 or 24 months after the delegated acts enter into force, whichever is later. The recycled-at-scale requirement applies from 1 January 2035 or five years after the implementing acts enter into force, whichever is later. Check the exemptions in Article 6(11).
For packaging placed on the EU market, t.da: For emballage, der bringes i omsætning i EU, gælder kriterierne for design til genanvendelse fra 1. januar 2030 eller 24 måneder efter de delegerede retsakters ikrafttræden, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Kravet om genanvendelse i stor skala gælder fra 1. januar 2035 eller fem år efter gennemførelsesretsakternes ikrafttræden, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Tjek undtagelserne i artikel 6, stk. 11.

For plastic parts covered by Article 7,.en: For plastic parts covered by Article 7, check the minimum recycled content for the packaging category. The first targets apply from 1 January 2030 or three years after the implementing act under Article 7(8) enters into force, whichever is later. Check exemptions, including for a plastic part below 5% of the total packaging-unit weight.
For plastic parts covered by Article 7,.da: For plastdele omfattet af artikel 7 skal I undersøge minimumskravet til genanvendt indhold for emballagetypen. De første krav gælder fra 1. januar 2030 eller tre år efter ikrafttrædelsen af gennemførelsesretsakten efter artikel 7, stk. 8, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Tjek undtagelserne, blandt andet for plastdele under 5 % af emballageenhedens samlede vægt.

Since 12 August 2026, food-contact packa.en: Since 12 August 2026, food-contact packaging placed on the EU market must meet the PFAS limits in Article 5(5). Ask the supplier for evidence for your packaging. Earlier manufacture gives no stock grace period. Packaging already placed on the EU market before that date may remain available.
Since 12 August 2026, food-contact packa.da: Siden 12. august 2026 skal fødevarekontaktemballage, der bringes i omsætning i EU, overholde PFAS-grænserne i artikel 5, stk. 5. Bed leverandøren om dokumentation for jeres emballage. Tidligere fremstilling giver ingen frist til at afvikle lageret. Emballage, der allerede var bragt i omsætning i EU før datoen, må fortsat være tilgængelig.

Confirm the intended use with the suppli.en: Confirm the intended use with the supplier. If the packaging is for food contact, check the PFAS limits and get evidence for the specific packaging.
Confirm the intended use with the suppli.da: Afklar den tilsigtede brug med leverandøren. Ved fødevarekontakt skal I tjekke PFAS-grænserne og indhente dokumentation for den konkrete emballage.

If you fill sales packaging, reduce empt.en: If you fill sales packaging, reduce empty space to what is needed for function and protection by 12 February 2028. If you fill grouped, transport or e-commerce packaging, the maximum is 50% from 1 January 2030 or three years after the relevant implementing acts enter into force, whichever is later. Fill material counts as empty space. Sales packs used as e-commerce packs and reusable packs in a reuse system are exempt from the 50% rule. Check Article 24(4) and (5) for the precise conditions.
If you fill sales packaging, reduce empt.da: Fylder I salgsemballage, skal tomrummet senest 12. februar 2028 begrænses til det nødvendige for funktion og beskyttelse. Fylder I multipak-, transport- eller e-handelsemballage, er grænsen 50 % fra 1. januar 2030 eller tre år efter de relevante gennemførelsesretsakters ikrafttræden, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Fyldmateriale tæller som tomrum. Salgsemballage brugt som e-handelsemballage og genbrugsemballage i et genbrugssystem er undtaget fra 50 %-reglen. Tjek artikel 24, stk. 4 og 5, for de præcise betingelser.

Confirm that no relevant supply or unpac.en: Confirm that no relevant supply or unpacking takes place in the EU. Ask what packaging and documentation rules apply at the destination.
Confirm that no relevant supply or unpac.da: Afklar, om der er relevant tilgængeliggørelse eller udpakning i EU. Undersøg emballage- og dokumentationskravene på destinationsmarkedet.

We place packaging or packed products fr.da: Vi bringer emballage eller emballerede varer fra et tredjeland i omsætning i EU

The harmonised material-composition labe.en: The harmonised material-composition label generally applies from 12 August 2028 or 24 months after the relevant implementing acts enter into force, whichever is later. Check Article 12 for exceptions and other labelling deadlines.
The harmonised material-composition labe.da: Det harmoniserede mærke om materialesammensætning gælder som hovedregel fra 12. august 2028 eller 24 måneder efter de relevante gennemførelsesretsakters ikrafttræden, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Tjek artikel 12 for undtagelser og andre mærkningsfrister.
